description: BiBLE CC Plugin hooks — bridge Claude Code lifecycle to daemon HTTP API. All hook data (session_id, prompt, tool_name, etc.) is read from stdin JSON — no shell variables needed.

hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" && uv run python -m bible_cc_plugin.scripts.hook session-start
cd "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" && uv run python -m bible_cc_plugin.scripts.hook turn-user
cd "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" && uv run python -m bible_cc_plugin.scripts.hook turn-tool
cd "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" && uv run python -m bible_cc_plugin.scripts.hook turn-stop
cd "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" && uv run python -m bible_cc_plugin.scripts.hook session-end
